title: Ratified P3E container gate family (P3E-CTR)

supersedes.file: this file's own PROPOSED predecessor (schema p3e-container-gate-family-proposal.v1)
supersedes.note: the proposal numbered twelve gates including four evidence steps; the ratified family renumbers, so a P3E-CTR identifier in the proposal does not necessarily denote the same gate here. Only this ratified file is authoritative.

what_ratification_means: Ratification defines requirements only. It does NOT execute any gate, mark any gate passed, or assert that any gate has ever run. Every gate below is NOT_EXECUTED.

P3E-CTR-01.requirement: base-images.json and every Dockerfile FROM pin equal the owner-ratified digests in BASE_IMAGE_MIRROR_DECISION.json
P3E-CTR-01.evidence_required_before_passed: this gate's step exits zero in a run whose container build succeeded from the ratified digests, with its log or uploaded artifact retained, and every mandatory evidence obligation attached to it satisfied

P3E-CTR-13.requirement: the container terminates before binding any network listener when its startup integrity checks fail: missing certificate, missing key, certificate/key mismatch, missing credentials, or malformed password hash
P3E-CTR-13.case_requirement: each case must terminate before network binding; a container that binds and then errors does not satisfy this gate

claim_distinction.this_gate_claims: the built, running container fails closed before binding, verified against real `docker run` invocations of the image
claim_distinction.in_process_coverage_claims: deployment/governance-studio/tests/test_startup_integrity.py verifies the same fail-closed properties in-process against the ASGI application, without a container
claim_distinction.why_distinct: in-process coverage cannot observe image packaging, entrypoint behaviour or actual port binding, so it corroborates this gate but does not discharge it

P3E-CTR-13.runtime_split_note: sixth gate mapped to the container-runtime-verification step, appended by owner ruling without renumbering P3E-CTR-01 through P3E-CTR-12
P3E-CTR-13.evidence_required_before_passed: this gate's section exits zero in a run whose container build succeeded from the ratified digests, with its log or uploaded artifact retained, and every mandatory evidence obligation attached to it satisfied

evidence_obligations.rule: Mandatory evidence obligations are not independent verification gates. Missing mandatory evidence makes a run INCOMPLETE; it does not fail a verification gate and does not add one.
evidence_obligations.run_completion_rule: a run is COMPLETE only when every mandatory obligation is satisfied; an incomplete run cannot be reported as a passing family run

family_evidence_role.rationale: An SBOM inventories image contents. It does not independently establish source commit, builder identity or trusted-build provenance, so it may contribute to a provenance claim but can never satisfy one on its own.
family_evidence_role.owner_ruling: rasaha, 2026-08-29: the earlier attachment to P3E-CTR-03 is removed and no substitute gate attachment is invented.

image-sbom.previous_attachment_withdrawn: P3E-CTR-03 (container build) - withdrawn by owner ruling; not replaced by another gate attachment

evidence-manifest.produces: hashed manifest of the run's evidence artifacts

non_compensatory_rule.statement: these gates are non-compensatory: each must pass on its own, and success in any of them never offsets, substitutes for, or mitigates failure in another

relationship_to_the_historical_C_family.statement: NO correspondence between any P3E-CTR identifier and any historical C identifier is asserted, implied or intended, in either direction. The families are independent. Do not map, equate or align them by position, count, ordering or name similarity.

prohibited_without_further_ratification: treating any P3E-CTR identifier as equivalent to any historical C identifier
marking any gate in either family passed
reporting a run with unsatisfied mandatory evidence obligations as complete
compensating a failed runtime gate with a passing sibling
amendment_2026_08_29: Owner ruling: P3E-CTR-13 (fail-closed startup integrity) appended as a thirteenth non-compensatory gate covering verify_container.sh §11, which the original five-way runtime split left unassigned. The image-sbom obligation's attachment to P3E-CTR-03 is withdrawn; the SBOM stays attached to P3E-CTR-11 and carries the family-level IMAGE_PROVENANCE role marked CONTRIBUTORY_NOT_SUFFICIENT.
unassigned_residue_resolved: the §11 startup-failure negatives previously recorded as unassigned are now ratified as P3E-CTR-13
